units.source_text: 红梅藤大纳言奉圣旨前来迎接匂皇子返宫。

en.t: The Ko-bai Fuji Major Counselor came by imperial command to escort Prince Niou back to the palace.

units.source_text: 大批人马云集，开路喝道，直向帝都归去。

en.t: A great crowd of attendants and horses gathered, clearing the road with loud calls as they headed straight back to the capital.

units.source_text: 许多青年公子游兴尚未餍足，一路上恋恋不舍，屡屡回顾。

en.t: Many young noblemen had not yet had their fill of pleasure, and all along the way they looked back again and again with lingering regret.

units.source_text: 匂皇子只想另觅适当机会，再度来游。

en.t: Prince Niou thought only of finding another suitable chance to come and enjoy himself there again.

units.source_text: 此时樱花盛开，云霞旖旎，春色正当好处。

en.t: At this time the cherry blossoms were in full bloom, the clouds and haze were lovely, and the spring scenery was at its finest.

units.source_text: 诸人所作汉诗、和歌甚多。

en.t: The Chinese poems and waka composed by everyone were very numerous.

units.source_text: 为避烦琐，不曾一一探询。

en.t: To avoid tedious detail, they were not investigated one by one.
